blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Antipolo Bishop Ruperto Cruz Santos criticized the government for allegedly concealing urban poverty during the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. “What is shameful is when we ourselves are the cause of their poverty. What is shameful is that even amid their poverty, they continue to be robbed, exploited, and deceived,” according to the bishop’s post on the Roman Catholic Diocese of Antipolo’s official Facebook page in a post in Filipino on Tuesday. “Do not hide poverty. Do not hide the poor,” read an accompanying poster card. READ: Tinio: Poverty being concealed from Asean summit The […]...
